top_signals.title: Innovation Doesn't Happen Without Crisis: Rolapp
top_signals.summary: Brian Rolapp, CEO of PGA Tour, joins Scarlet Fu and Tom Keene on "Bloomberg Money." They discuss the changing landscape of sports media coverage, the rising costs of streaming bills for consumers, and the evolution of the PGA Tour after the rise and fall of LIV Golf. (Source: Bloomberg)
